summary: Jeremiah promises Johanan and the remnant of Judah peace and safety if they remain in Judah, but the sword, famine, and pestilence if they go to Egypt.
meta_description: Jeremiah promises Johanan and the remnant of Judah peace and safety if they remain in Judah, but the sword, famine, and pestilence if they go to Egypt.

footnotes.note10_a: IE I feel compassion regarding the punishment I bring upon you. JST Jer. 42:10 … and I will turn away the evil that I have done unto you.
